stops.title: Welcome
stops.notes: Say hello and what the talk is about.

stops.title: What a slide does
stops.notes: A slide is a scene: it builds in, then holds.
Each bullet is its own stop, so you talk to one point at a time.
The stops live in slides.json; Studio's Slides tab edits them.

stops.title: Present it
stops.notes: Present plays the deck full screen and holds at every stop.

stops.title: One source, two outputs
stops.notes: The same code renders a video and an HTML deck.

stops.title: Make it yours
stops.notes: Select a slide's text in the preview to edit it in the Props panel.
A new slide is one more Slide in src/video.rs with its own key.
Notes like these go into exported decks, so keep them shareable.
